topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Path of Fastest Descent

sections.title: Hook: The Gravity Slide Challenge (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: What path gets a marble down fastest?
A straight line seems the most direct.
But a curved path can gain speed earlier.
animations: 1. Fade in a marble on an inclined plane (#FFFFFF). Color code: #FFFFFF.
2. Marble accelerates down the plane; change marble color to #FFD700. Color code: #FFD700.
3. Overlay a curved path (#00FFFF) next to the straight path (#FFD700). Color code: #00FFFF.

sections.title: Prerequisite Intuition: Energy and Velocity (0:45-1:30)
lecture_lines: Gravity converts potential energy into kinetic energy.
Steeper starts yield higher initial velocities.
Gaining speed early minimizes travel time.
animations: 1. Animate energy bars: Potential (#00FF00) depleting as Kinetic (#FFD700) increases. Color code: #00FF00.
2. Display v = sqrt(2gh) equation on screen (#FFFFFF). Color code: #FFFFFF.
3. Show marble gaining speed early on a steep incline (#FFD700). Color code: #FFD700.

sections.title: Defining the Shape: The Cycloid (1:30-2:30)
lecture_lines: The solution is a curve called a cycloid.
It is traced by a rolling wheel's rim.
This shape balances distance and speed perfectly.
animations: 1. Animate a circle rolling along a horizontal line (#FFFFFF). Color code: #FFFFFF.
2. Trace the path of a point on the rim (#00FFFF). Color code: #00FFFF.
3. Finalize the cycloid shape clearly on the screen (#FFD700). Color code: #FFD700.
4. Overlay a parabola (#FF4500) against the cycloid (#FFD700). Color code: #FF4500.
5. Highlight the cycloid smooth transition property (#00FF00). Color code: #00FF00.

sections.title: The Calculus of Variations (2:30-4:00)
lecture_lines: We minimize total time as a functional.
Euler-Lagrange equations find the stationary point.
This calculus proves the cycloid is fastest.
Small path deviations increase the travel time.
Nature optimizes paths to reach the minimum.
animations: 1. Write the time integral functional on screen (#FFFFFF). Color code: #FFFFFF.
2. Reveal Euler-Lagrange terms one by one (#FFD700). Color code: #FFD700.
3. Show a variational perturbation on a curve (#FF4500). Color code: #FF4500.
4. Morph curve towards the optimal cycloid (#00FFFF). Color code: #00FFFF.
5. Display final "Min Time" text prominently (#00FF00). Color code: #00FF00.

sections.title: Real-World Application & Summary (4:00-5:00)
lecture_lines: Engineers use these curves for rollercoasters.
Nature often favors efficiency over distance.
animations: 1. Display a graphic of a falcon diving (#FFFFFF). Color code: #FFFFFF.
2. Compare travel times using a bar graph (#FFD700). Color code: #FFD700.
3. List key efficiency points on the screen (#00FFFF). Color code: #00FFFF.
